newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Thai Farmers, Bangkok Bank to grow.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Thai Farmers, Bangkok Bank to grow.

text.p: Thai Farmers Bank Plc and Bangkok Bank Plc will be the only top Thai banks to see earnings growth this year, Vickers Ballas research said in a report on Thursday.
"Only BBL and TFB are expected to record positive earnings growth, albeit very moderate," the report said.
Vickers said it expected to see earnings of the top six Thai banks, which increased by around seven percent in 1996, to fall by three percent in 1997.
"Bank earnings are expected to fall by three percent in 1997. This is somewhat distorted by low but positive growth for our two "outperform" recommendations TFB and BBL," it added.

In assigning an overall neutral rating to the Thai banking sector, which contributed more than 50 percent of total profits of all Thai-listed firms last year, Vickers said most large commercial banks can easily meet new central bank provisioning requirements.
On Monday the Bank of Thailand ordered all commercial banks to increase provisioning to cover 15 percent of sub-standard debts.

"Most banks come close to meeting the 15 percent rule already, with BBL having substantial excess provisions. However Thai Military Bank and Krung Thai Bank will be required to set large provisions to meet this new guideline," Vickers said.
Further selling pressure in bank, finance and securities stocks will continue in the short-term though the downside is limited as market prices have largely discounted further bad news, Vickers said.
"Negative sentiment toward the banking and finance sectors as a whole are expected to continue to exert considerable short-term pressure accross the board," the report said.
